description: Per-domain concept-lattice knowledge bases — one per scenario, matching CPAM-LLM Figs 2b–6b but FULLER than the simplified figures. For every concept and every constraint we give the formal representation: a one-line description, the constraint in mathematical notation, and a docplex.cp code template. This is the structural knowledge the RAG-FCA stage hands to the LLM (it resolves a query's constraints to these formal templates), so the second stage can build the formal model and CP code.

field_guide.anchor: problem-type tag every problem of the scenario carries
field_guide.base_constraints: constraints present in EVERY problem of the scenario
field_guide.additional_constraints: optional constraint types; dataset_constraint_id is the numbered id used in the source `Constraint` column; relaxes (if set) means this variant REMOVES that base constraint
field_guide.concepts: formal concepts of this domain's sub-lattice; each lists its constraint intent split into objective/base/additional, all formalized
field_guide.implications: Duquenne-Guigues implications internal to this domain
field_guide.hasse_edges: cover relations between this domain's concepts

anchor.name: aircraft_skin_processing
anchor.desc: Flexible job-shop scheduling of aircraft-skin operations on multiple robots/machines.
anchor.math: problem class: FJSP; jobs J, operations O_{j,s}, machines M
anchor.cp: # interval vars O[j,s]; machine assignment M_s(O[j,s])

base_constraints.name: resource_flexibility
base_constraints.desc: Each operation is assigned to one of its eligible machines.

base_constraints.name: operation_precedence
base_constraints.desc: Operations of a job run in their predefined order.

base_constraints.name: resource_capacity_no_overlap
base_constraints.desc: A machine processes at most one operation at a time.

base_constraints.name: non_preemption
base_constraints.desc: Operations are atomic interval activities (no preemption).
base_constraints.math: O_{j,s} is a non-preemptive interval of fixed length

additional_constraints.name: job_start_time_window
additional_constraints.desc: A job's first operation must start within a time window.

additional_constraints.name: job_temporal_bounds
additional_constraints.desc: All operations of a job lie within [lb, ub].

additional_constraints.name: inter_job_precedence
additional_constraints.desc: All operations of one job precede all of another.

additional_constraints.name: operation_level_precedence
additional_constraints.desc: A specific operation must follow a specific operation of another job.

additional_constraints.name: operation_end_time_window
additional_constraints.desc: A specific operation must finish within a time window.

additional_constraints.name: sequence_dependent_setup
additional_constraints.desc: Setup time when a machine switches between different jobs.
additional_constraints.math: transition time = 20 on same machine when job changes

all_constraints.math: problem class: facility location; sites F, demand areas C

all_constraints.name: demand_allocation
all_constraints.desc: Station load is the packed demand of its assigned areas.

all_constraints.name: demand_area_expansion

all_constraints.name: demand_coverage
all_constraints.desc: Every demand area's charging demand is fully served.
all_constraints.math: each area c is assigned to an open station covering its demand

all_constraints.name: dna_sequence_design
all_constraints.desc: DNA nanostructure sequence design under biophysical constraints.
all_constraints.math: problem class: sequence design; sequences W_i, length L, bases {A,T,G,C}=={0,1,2,3}

all_constraints.name: faulty_module_isolation
all_constraints.desc: A faulty module stays offline in every period.

all_constraints.math: find any assignment satisfying all constraints

all_constraints.name: inter_job_precedence

all_constraints.name: job_start_time_window
all_constraints.desc: A job's first operation must start within a time window.

all_constraints.name: job_temporal_bounds
all_constraints.desc: All operations of a job lie within [lb, ub].

all_constraints.name: load_demand_satisfaction
all_constraints.desc: Activated configuration meets the period's load demand.
all_constraints.math: selected modules satisfy load voltage & current each period

all_constraints.name: location_exclusion

all_constraints.name: max_module_current

all_constraints.name: minimize_makespan
all_constraints.desc: Minimize the maximum completion time.
